items.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020
items.q: I think it’s just an extension of the drumming devices pioneered by Kenny Clarke

ctx.x: When did you learn that that works?

Well what you are referring to, I can remember I would, in the middle of the fill I would play the snare drum and the hi hat and the hi hat is open and it’s sustaining and ringing and the expectation is that, one, two, three, [scats] you know, that one. And the one is being played somewhere else and so the drums don’t need to do it. And if anything I think it’s just an extension of the drumming devices pioneered by Kenny Clarke where you know some of the earlier bebop recordings, instead of playing on the…
And one of the tunes was yours, right?
